interpretation: The locked decoder passes the preregistered native publisher-validation gate. Attribution is exactly preserved by frozen-base fallback. Narrative gains five correct units out of 1,449, so that effect is positive but small. Scene is the substantive memory gain: micro-F1 rises by 0.09072 because memory removes 527 false positives while accepting 33 additional false negatives.
claim_boundary: This establishes a positive one-shot publisher-validation result for the locked routed decoder, not a general claim that every task or every memory training run improves. Publisher test and Hard32 remain unopened.

next_direction.retain: the exact frozen attribution, selective narrative, and direct memory scene decoder
next_direction.replicate: repeat the full train-to-validation pipeline under a new preregistered training seed before making a broad robustness claim
next_direction.quantify: add paired uncertainty intervals without changing predictions or tuning from validation rows
next_direction.protected_split_rule: do not tune on publisher validation, publisher test, or Hard32
